sn55.7:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosalesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ yena veḷudvāraṃ nāma kosalānaṃ brāhmaṇagāmo tadavasari.
sn55.7:1.4: samaṇo khalu bho gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito kosalesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ veḷudvāraṃ anuppatto.
sn55.7:1.5: taṃ kho pana bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ evaṃkalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato
sn55.7:1.6: itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti.
sn55.7:1.7: so imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ samārakaṃ sabrahmakaṃ sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiṃ pajaṃ sadevamanussaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedeti
sn55.7:1.8: so dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti
sn55.7:1.9: sādhu kho pana tathārūpānaṃ arahataṃ dassanaṃ hotīti.
sn55.7:2.1: atha kho veḷudvāreyyakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā appekacce bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu appekacce bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu appekacce yena bhagavā tenañjalimpaṇāmetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu appekacce bhagavato santike nāmagottaṃ sāvetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu appekacce tuṇhībhūtā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te veḷudvāreyyakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ
sn55.7:2.2: mayaṃ bho gotama evaṃkāmā evaṃchandā evaṃadhippāyā
sn55.7:2.3: puttasambādhā sayanaṃ ajjhāvaseyyāma kāsikacandanaṃ paccanubhaveyyāma mālāgandhavilepanaṃ dhāreyyāma jātarūparajataṃ sādiyeyyāma kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjeyyāma
sn55.7:2.4: tesaṃ no bhavaṃ gotamo amhākaṃ evaṃkāmānaṃ evaṃchandānaṃ evaṃadhippāyānaṃ tathā dhammaṃ desetu yathā mayaṃ puttasambādhā sayanaṃ ajjhāvaseyyāma …pe… sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjeyyāmāti.
sn55.7:3.3: evaṃ bhoti kho te veḷudvāreyyakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
sn55.7:4.3: ahaṃ khosmi jīvitukāmo amaritukāmo sukhakāmo dukkhapaṭikūlo
sn55.7:4.4: yo kho maṃ jīvitukāmaṃ amaritukāmaṃ sukhakāmaṃ dukkhapaṭikūlaṃ jīvitā voropeyya na me taṃ assa piyaṃ manāpaṃ
sn55.7:4.5: ahañceva kho pana paraṃ jīvitukāmaṃ amaritukāmaṃ sukhakāmaṃ dukkhapaṭikūlaṃ jīvitā voropeyyaṃ parassapi taṃ assa appiyaṃ amanāpaṃ
sn55.7:4.6: yo kho myāyaṃ dhammo appiyo amanāpo parassapeso dhammo appiyo amanāpo
sn55.7:4.7: yo kho myāyaṃ dhammo appiyo amanāpo kathāhaṃ parantena saññojeyyanti.
sn55.7:4.8: so iti paṭisaṅkhāya attanā ca pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti parañca pāṇātipātā veramaṇiyā samādapeti pāṇātipātā veramaṇiyā ca vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati.
sn55.7:5.1: puna caparaṃ gahapatayo ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati
sn55.7:5.2: yo kho me adinnaṃ theyyasaṅkhātaṃ ādiyeyya na me taṃ assa piyaṃ manāpaṃ
sn55.7:5.3: ahañceva kho pana parassa adinnaṃ theyyasaṅkhātaṃ ādiyeyyaṃ parassapi taṃ assa appiyaṃ amanāpaṃ
sn55.7:5.4: yo kho myāyaṃ dhammo appiyo amanāpo parassapeso dhammo appiyo amanāpo
sn55.7:5.5: yo kho myāyaṃ dhammo appiyo amanāpo kathāhaṃ parantena saññojeyyanti.
sn55.7:5.6: so iti paṭisaṅkhāya attanā ca adinnādānā paṭivirato hoti parañca adinnādānā veramaṇiyā samādapeti adinnādānā veramaṇiyā ca vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati.
sn55.7:6.1: puna caparaṃ gahapatayo ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati
sn55.7:6.2: yo kho me dāresu cārittaṃ āpajjeyya na me taṃ assa piyaṃ manāpaṃ
sn55.7:6.3: ahañceva kho pana parassa dāresu cārittaṃ āpajjeyyaṃ parassapi taṃ assa appiyaṃ amanāpaṃ
sn55.7:6.4: yo kho myāyaṃ dhammo appiyo amanāpo parassapeso dhammo appiyo amanāpo
sn55.7:6.5: yo kho myāyaṃ dhammo appiyo amanāpo kathāhaṃ parantena saññojeyyanti.
sn55.7:6.6: so iti paṭisaṅkhāya attanā ca kāmesu micchācārā paṭivirato hoti parañca kāmesu micchācārā veramaṇiyā samādapeti kāmesu micchācārā veramaṇiyā ca vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati.
sn55.7:7.1: puna caparaṃ gahapatayo ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati
sn55.7:7.2: yo kho me musāvādena atthaṃ bhañjeyya na me taṃ assa piyaṃ manāpaṃ
sn55.7:7.3: ahañceva kho pana parassa musāvādena atthaṃ bhañjeyyaṃ parassapi taṃ assa appiyaṃ amanāpaṃ
sn55.7:7.4: yo kho myāyaṃ dhammo appiyo amanāpo parassapeso dhammo appiyo amanāpo
sn55.7:7.5: yo kho myāyaṃ dhammo appiyo amanāpo kathāhaṃ parantena saññojeyyanti.
sn55.7:7.6: so iti paṭisaṅkhāya attanā ca musāvādā paṭivirato hoti parañca musāvādā veramaṇiyā samādapeti musāvādā veramaṇiyā ca vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati.
sn55.7:8.1: puna caparaṃ gahapatayo ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati
sn55.7:8.2: yo kho maṃ pisuṇāya vācāya mittehi bhedeyya na me taṃ assa piyaṃ manāpaṃ
sn55.7:8.3: ahañceva kho pana paraṃ pisuṇāya vācāya mittehi bhedeyyaṃ parassapi taṃ assa appiyaṃ amanāpaṃ …pe…
sn55.7:9.1: puna caparaṃ gahapatayo ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati
sn55.7:9.2: yo kho maṃ pharusāya vācāya samudācareyya na me taṃ assa piyaṃ manāpaṃ
sn55.7:9.3: ahañceva kho pana paraṃ pharusāya vācāya samudācareyyaṃ parassapi taṃ assa appiyaṃ amanāpaṃ
sn55.7:10.1: puna caparaṃ gahapatayo ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati
sn55.7:10.2: yo kho maṃ samphappalāpabhāsena samudācareyya na me taṃ assa piyaṃ manāpaṃ
sn55.7:10.3: ahañceva kho pana paraṃ samphappalāpabhāsena samudācareyyaṃ parassapi taṃ assa appiyaṃ amanāpaṃ
sn55.7:10.4: yo kho myāyaṃ dhammo appiyo amanāpo parassapeso dhammo appiyo amanāpo
sn55.7:10.5: yo kho myāyaṃ dhammo appiyo amanāpo kathāhaṃ parantena saññojeyyanti.
sn55.7:10.6: so iti paṭisaṅkhāya attanā ca samphappalāpā paṭivirato hoti parañca samphappalāpā veramaṇiyā samādapeti samphappalāpā veramaṇiyā ca vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati.
sn55.7:11.2: itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti.
sn55.7:11.4: saṅghe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti supaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho …pe… anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassāti.
sn55.7:11.5: ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akkhaṇḍehi acchiddehi asabalehi akammāsehi bhujissehi viññūpasatthehi aparāmaṭṭhehi samādhisaṃvattanikehi.
sn55.7:11.6: yato kho gahapatayo ariyasāvako imehi sattahi saddhammehi samannāgato hoti imehi catūhi ākaṅkhiyehi ṭhānehi so ākaṅkhamāno attanāva attānaṃ byākareyya
sn55.7:11.7: khīṇanirayomhi khīṇatiracchānayoniyo khīṇapittivisayo khīṇāpāyaduggativinipāto sotāpannohamasmi avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyanoti.
sn55.7:12.1: evaṃ vutte veḷudvāreyyakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ
sn55.7:12.3: ete mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāma dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca
sn55.7:12.4: upāsake no bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupete saraṇaṅgateti.
